facts.text: Based on the 1925 Theodore Dreiser novel, An American Tragedy, the opera was commissioned by the Metropolitan Opera, and premiered in New York City on December 2, 2005.

facts.text: An American Tragedy is an opera in two acts composed by Tobias Picker, with a libretto by Gene Scheer.
